trust_decision.summary: pac4j-oidc decides which user (and which roles) a login belongs to: identity comes from the validated ID token, but it accepts an access token on its own at the callback, takes the UserInfo response (fetched with that access token) without checking its subject against the ID token, and reads Keycloak roles from the access token without verifying its signature.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'access token substitution' in the OIDC callback; the extractor is where the callback turns code/id_token/access_token parameters into credentials and currently accepts an access token alone.

fix_sites.entry_point: OIDC callback profile creation (OidcProfileCreator.create -> callUserInfoEndpoint, public method); also reached by OidcClient.renewUserProfile and by TokenCredentials bearer calls
AuthorizationGenerator.generate run after profile creation for KeycloakOidcClient; also a public class users attach to any client
KeycloakOidcClient init (wires the generator; fix passes the OidcConfiguration so it can validate)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Keycloak roles generator is a vendor-specific authorization add-on that runs after authentication succeeds; a solver can argue authentication bypass is closed in the extractor/profile creator and the access token 'came from the trusted token endpoint' in the default code flow.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Keycloak access tokens whose 'aud' lacks the client id but whose 'azp' equals it must still yield roles (fix adds an azp fallback that re-runs the other claim checks); an id_token-only implicit response must still be accepted; UserInfo must still set the id when no ID token is present (blank id).

O6_input_shapes: callback with access_token only vs with code vs with id_token only (fix.diff:569-572)
UserInfo returned as plain JSON vs as a signed/encrypted UserInfo JWT (pac4j-oidc/src/main/java/org/pac4j/oidc/profile/creator/OidcProfileCreator.java:204-208)
UserInfo with blank subject vs mismatching subject vs matching subject, compared after ProfileHelper.sanitizeIdentifier (fix.diff:586-599)

Keycloak access token: unsigned PlainJWT, wrong signature, expired, aud without client but matching azp, neither aud nor azp matching, generator built without configuration (fix.diff:526-542, fix.diff:489-492)

O7_producer.where: pac4j-oidc/src/main/java/org/pac4j/oidc/profile/OidcProfile.java:130-166 (access token stored as base64 JSON profile attribute, later re-parsed by the Keycloak generator)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Opt-in access-token claims merge validates the access token as an ID token but never compares its subject to the ID token subject before adding its claims to the profile.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Off by default (pac4j-oidc/src/main/java/org/pac4j/oidc/config/OidcConfiguration.java:239), signature is verified, 'sub' is skipped and existing attributes are not overwritten.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the UserInfo fix, different method

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Implicit 'id_token token' flow: the front-channel access token is never bound to the validated ID token (no at_hash check in the validator) and is stored in the profile; with UserInfo disabled nothing compares it to the ID token subject.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Implicit flow is legacy/non-default (pac4j-oidc/src/main/java/org/pac4j/oidc/config/OidcConfiguration.java:119-121, default code flow at :199) and UserInfo is on by default (:243).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different class from landing point, same module

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Profile expiration is taken from the 'exp' claim of the unvalidated access token JWT.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only affects session lifetime, not identity or roles.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An Azure AD 'roles'/'groups' authorization generator that reads claims from the access token by plain JWT parse, mirroring the Keycloak one.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Azure AD puts app roles in access tokens and the Keycloak generator already shows the parse-without-validate idiom in the same module.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Renewed profile from a refresh grant whose UserInfo/ID token subject is not compared to the existing profile id.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: renewUserProfile rebuilds the profile through the same creator; a maintainer could easily add a renewal path that trusts the new subject.

O9_family: authentication bypass / insufficient verification of data authenticity (token binding: access token not bound to validated ID token subject; unsigned JWT claims trusted)

O10_build.project_tests: pac4j-oidc/src/test/java/org/pac4j/oidc/credentials/extractor/OidcCredentialsExtractorTests.java, pac4j-oidc/src/test/java/org/pac4j/oidc/profile/creator/OidcProfileCreatorTests.java (fix adds tests using a local in-process WebServer for UserInfo), pac4j-oidc/src/test/java/org/pac4j/oidc/authorization/generator/KeycloakRolesAuthorizationGeneratorTests.java

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject access-token-only callbacks in the extractor and stop there, or validate the Keycloak access token with the plain ID-token validator (breaking the azp-only audience case).

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit 2270c3ff bundles unrelated security fixes: logout open redirect (pac4j-core DefaultLogoutLogic isUrlAllowedForRedirect + Pac4jConstants pattern), reversed CheckProfileTypeAuthorizer check, SAML unsigned NameID LogoutRequest, OAuth2 withState warning; candidate metadata c_same_check_name=isUrlAllowedForRedirect refers to the open-redirect fix, not this advisory.
After the fix, KeycloakRolesAuthorizationGenerator validates the access token but does not compare its 'sub' to the profile id (fix.diff:522-543); not pursued.
